partially_covered.missing: No explicit property or structure to enumerate all organization-related information in a single view; information is distributed among properties and requires inference.
ValidationConstraint class exists, but there are no explicit axioms or SHACL shapes for required fields/consistency; only the structural placeholder is present.

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are directly answerable via classes and properties. CQ5 and CQ13 require additional modeling for full coverage, particularly regarding organization attribute aggregation and explicit validation constraints.

strengths: Rich, multi-level class hierarchy reflecting EDIFACT structure
Comprehensive use of disjointness and inverse properties
weaknesses: No use of GCAs or equivalence axioms for semantic richness
No advanced OWL restrictions (e.g., cardinality, value constraints)
Disjointness is present but could be expanded for more granular classes

reasoner_risks: Hermit may warn on missing restrictions for ValidationConstraint or complex inverse property chains

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add explicit axioms or SHACL shapes for mandatory EDIFACT/D96A fields (e.g., invoice number, buyer/seller identifiers) to fully support CQ13.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables automated validation and ensures file format compliance.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model an OrganizationView class or property chain to aggregate all information about involved organizations for CQ5.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Easier querying and improved semantic clarity for organization-related questions.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) and owl:equivalentClass axioms to define key concepts (e.g., define BuyerRoleAssignment as RoleAssignment with AgentRole code 'BY').
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves reasoning and enables more powerful queries and consistency checks.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add cardinality and value restrictions (e.g., InvoiceMessage must have exactly one invoice number, at least one buyer and seller).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Strengthens logical rigor and supports validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand EDIFACTSegment/Composite/SimpleElement with a vocabulary of actual segment codes, data element codes, and example instances.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves technical completeness and enables code-level validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add rdfs:seeAlso and skos:notation for interoperability with EN 16931-1 and P2P-O standards.

summary: The ontology demonstrates a rich and well-structured model for EDIFACT invoices, with strong coverage of the story and most competency questions. It adheres to OWL 2 best practices and is validator-friendly, but could be improved by adding explicit validation constraints, advanced OWL constructs, and more detailed EDIFACT code vocabularies.
